source.ref: Maharashtra transport/metro surcharge on stamp duty (in abeyance to 31-Mar-2022 per MRD-3320/C.No.24/UD-7; effective 1-Apr-2022)
source.quoted_text: Widely reported (AZB Partners; Free Press Journal, Mar 2022): a 1% Metro Cess / transport surcharge applies, in addition to stamp duty, on SALE, GIFT and MORTGAGE documents executed from 1 April 2022 in the six metro-project cities — Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Pune, Nagpur and Nashik. The cess had been kept in abeyance from 1-Apr-2020 (notification MRD-3320/C.No.24/UD-7) until 31-Mar-2022. Computed as 1% of the market value (same base as stamp duty).

pending_verification.reason: The 1% metro cess is encoded from press reporting (AZB; Free Press Journal), not from the gazette notification itself — sources hierarchy §8 forbids that as a sole basis for a live rate. Founder to source the notification and its authoritative city list. Separately, Maharashtra Local Body Tax (LBT) is levied in some corporations and is NOT encoded at all, so a total in an LBT corporation is understated.

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM (multiple corroborating sources incl. a law firm + the abeyance-notification reference, but NOT read from a .gov primary PDF — PENDING the exact notification number/text). 1% of market value, in the six metro cities, from 1-Apr-2022 → makes a Municipal-Corporation conveyance 5%+1% = 6%. fact metro_cess_city='yes' (property in Mumbai/Thane/Navi Mumbai/Pune/Nagpur/Nashik). Currently attached to CONVEYANCE only; the cess also applies to GIFT and MORTGAGE (attach when those are metro-city-tested — note it should NOT inflate a fixed family-gift stamp figure but IS charged on the property value, a modelling point to confirm). LBT, where separately levied, may be additional — PENDING.
